name: RH56H1
summary: RH56H1 is INSPIRE ROBOTS' compact five-finger hand for robotic manipulation, measuring approximately 160 mm high and weighing 470 ±10 g. It provides six degrees of freedom across 11 joints. The manufacturer specifies tactile arrays with 34 points on each fingertip and 90 points on the palm, together with ±0.2 mm repeatability and a closing time of no more than 0.8 seconds. RS485 and CAN FD are listed, with an EtherCAT-equipped configuration also available. Thumb and other-finger forces are specified separately.
